description: Emails sent, replies, interested leads and meetings booked between two dates (inclusive). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the last 30 days.

from.description: First day to count, e.g. 2026-11-01. Leave out for 30 days before the end date.

to.description: Last day to count, included, e.g. 2026-11-30. Leave out for today.

name: results

meetings.description: Meetings booked that are still scheduled.

replies.description: Prospects who replied (auto-replies and bounces excluded).

title: Results for a period
